content.comment_body: Good morning everyone! I'm trying to run the [product_name] application (Navigation), but when I transfer the project structure to the [product_name], I get some error messages. Is it possible to use the Web Navigation feature without saving the program to the SD card?
No, the [product_name] project must be stored on the SD card in the [product_name] device.
